_about: Digests of v1's catalogue tables (v1 commit 4bb9c6bf bootstrap of the 38 statement and 8 numeric-note templates). Each is sha256 of the sorted rows as JSON.

queries.concept_nodes: select concept_uuid, template_id, parent_uuid, kind, canonical_label, render_sheet, render_row, render_col, matrix_col, matrix_col_label, is_current from concept_nodes
queries.concept_edges: select parent_uuid, child_uuid, coefficient from concept_edges
queries.concept_targets: select concept_uuid, entity_scope, period, target_sheet, target_row, target_col from concept_targets
queries.concept_render_aliases: select concept_uuid, alias_sheet, alias_row, alias_col from concept_render_aliases
queries.concept_semantic_addresses: select concept_uuid, primary_concept, dimensions_json, taxonomy_version, address_version from concept_semantic_addresses
queries.taxonomy_concepts: select source_element_id, taxonomy_version, namespace_uri, local_name, abstract, concept_role, data_type, period_type, balance, substitution_group from taxonomy_concepts
queries.template_slots: select target_id, canonical_target_id, template_id, sheet, row, col, label, slot_role, value_kind, taxonomy_element_id, dimensions_json, mapping_source, manifest_version, workbook_fingerprint, validation_status, exception_code from template_slots
